title: Aouda declaration (aouda.json), version 1
description: aouda.json: what exists and who may do what, read by the server named by Aouda:Declaration (--declaration).

$schema.description: The JSON schema of this file, for an editor; the server ignores it and never fetches it.

version.description: The grammar's version. Required; 1 is the only one.

databases.description: The declared databases, keyed by database name.

additionalProperties.description: One declared database: created when missing and converged at every start; its name is the member's name.

kind.description: data (an ordinary database) or auth (an application auth database). Required.

authDatabase.description: data only: the application auth database this database is linked to.

schema.description: data only: the schema file applied at start, relative to this file's directory (or absolute). Its overlay for Aouda:Environment E is <stem>.E.json beside it.

schemaAllowDestructive.description: With schema: whether the start-time apply may drop tables and columns (default false; never on reload).

durability.description: strict (the default), os, unlogged or memory. An auth database is always strict.

writeConcernTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for the write concern's acknowledgements; at least 100 (default 5000).

memoryWeight.description: Relative weight of this database's memory share; positive (default 1).

maxMemoryShareBytes.description: Cap on the computed memory share, in bytes (default: none).

actions.description: read, write, delete, execute, manage, set-identity, or *.

where.description: A row condition (ADR 0071 D-9): a condition { column, op, value, principal, ignoreCase } or a group { and, or, groups }; checked by the server.

embargoSeconds.description: Rows newer than this many seconds are not read (ADR 0071 D-8).

unrestricted.description: An unconditional read anonymous or signup may hold on a row-scoped table (ADR 0071 D-9).

signup.description: Self-signup (ADR 0071 D-5): { "enabled", "roles"?, "statements"? }, what a principal that signs itself up holds.

roles.description: The roles of this auth database (auth only), keyed by role name (not admin, writer or reader: built in).

additionalProperties.description: A role of this auth database, owned by the declaration: created, converged and removed at every start and reload (source: declared).

actions.description: read, write, delete, execute, manage, set-identity, or *.

where.description: A row condition (ADR 0071 D-9): a condition { column, op, value, principal, ignoreCase } or a group { and, or, groups }; checked by the server.

embargoSeconds.description: Rows newer than this many seconds are not read (ADR 0071 D-8).

unrestricted.description: An unconditional read anonymous or signup may hold on a row-scoped table (ADR 0071 D-9).

statements.description: What the role grants: a non-empty list of statements (ADR 0071 D-6).

principals.description: The principals of this auth database (auth only), keyed by name (a slug or an email address); 'anonymous' declares what unauthenticated callers hold.

additionalProperties.description: A principal of this auth database, owned by the declaration (source: declared); its name is the member's name: a slug or an email address.

roles.description: The roles it holds: declared, built-in (admin, writer, reader) or runtime roles of its auth database.

actions.description: read, write, delete, execute, manage, set-identity, or *.

where.description: A row condition (ADR 0071 D-9): a condition { column, op, value, principal, ignoreCase } or a group { and, or, groups }; checked by the server.

embargoSeconds.description: Rows newer than this many seconds are not read (ADR 0071 D-8).

unrestricted.description: An unconditional read anonymous or signup may hold on a row-scoped table (ADR 0071 D-9).

statements.description: Its own statements (ADR 0071 D-6); may be empty.

attributes.description: Its attributes (ADR 0071 D-12): name → a string, number, boolean or an array of them; a where reads them as principal.<name>.

credentials.description: How the principal authenticates. Every secret is given by reference; none is a literal.

file.description: A file's path, relative to the declaration file's directory.

password.description: A password seed: { "file" }, { "env" } or { "hash": <the server's password-hasher output> }. Applied only when the principal is created, with forcePasswordChange; the principal must be named by an email.

keys.description: Stored keys: { "id": "aouda_<16>", "sha256": "<64 hex>" } each — the public id and the hash of the whole key, never the key.

id.description: The key's public id, aouda_ and 16 characters.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the whole key, 64 hexadecimal characters.

derivedKey.description: A key derived from keyRoot (ADR 0071 D-17): the same key after a wipe. Bump version to rotate it.

oidc.description: OIDC trusts (ADR 0071 D-18): a token whose issuer, audience, subject and claims match is exchanged for a session.

issuer.description: The issuer, an https URL, matched exactly.

claims.description: More claims the token must carry, name → exact value.

jwks.description: Where the issuer's keys are read: one of file or url (default: the issuer's discovery).

disabled.description: true refuses every credential of it (default false). Not for anonymous.

server.description: Who operates the server: the server auth database's roles and principals (ADR 0071 D-22). Its statements may name every database and server.

roles.description: The roles of the server auth database, keyed by role name (not admin, writer or reader: built in).
